name: Faceless
source:
"I want you to show me proof of 'true love'."

The "god", the "king", and the "judge" who created "The End". He is the greatest one of "The End".
He forces It to participate in his game.
Although he is a "god", he has no actual power, and is often mocked by the other inhabitants.

Cheerful and friendly, yet somewhat selfish.
He is very capricious, making it difficult for him to explain things logically.
